description.value: Bandra Cafe is an Indian cafe on White Rock's Marine Drive that pays homage to the street food culture and Irani cafes of Mumbai's Bandra neighbourhood. The menu spans Mumbai classics like Pav Bhaji, Pan Rolls, and Iranian-style Biryani alongside an extensive chai and coffee program. The cafe is fully licensed and has a second location on Scott Road in Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the White Rock location address (15519 Marine Dr) and phone number (+1 604-385-6398), and is clearly operational with an active menu and delivery platform links. The menu explicitly marks vegetarian items with '(v)' and gluten-free items with '(GF)', and the site states 'Order Now (takeout only)' with Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and Doordash integrations. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM tags show Tu-Su 11:00-20:00 but the website's White Rock location page shows Tuesday–Sunday 10:00AM to 6:00PM. The website value should be treated as more current.
OSM 'url' tag points to the brand root (https://bandracafe.com) while 'website' tag and actual location page are at https://bandracafe.com/location-white-rock — minor inconsistency in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant on Marine Drive in White Rock, a well-travelled cycling route; confirmed takeout and vegetarian/GF options make it a practical stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location brand; second location is at 7310 #110 120th Street, Surrey (Scott Road). The About Us page and footer consistently show the Surrey address as the primary contact, which may cause confusion for customers seeking the White Rock branch.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Order Now (takeout only)' and lists Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and Doordash as ordering platforms

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks vegetarian items with '(v)' (e.g. Pav Bhaji, Onion Bhajia, Patti Samosa) and gluten-free items with '(GF)' (e.g. Lucky's Bandra Biryani)

wow_evidence: second location on Scott Road in Surrey
